policy: Diagnostic codes are append-only. Retired codes remain reserved and must never be assigned a different meaning.

diagnostics.message: The current 3D camera may hide meaningful structure.
suggested_repairs: Rotate the scene or choose a camera preset.

diagnostics.message: The 3D scene has a degenerate spatial extent.
suggested_repairs: Expand a zero-width bound or use a lower-dimensional plot.

diagnostics.message: The 3D scene has an extreme aspect ratio.
suggested_repairs: Choose a manual aspect ratio or rescale the coordinates.

diagnostics.message: The plot has no useful alternative text.
suggested_repairs: Generate or provide a concise semantic plot description.

diagnostics.message: A logarithmic axis received non-positive data.
suggested_repairs: Remove non-positive values or choose a linear scale.

diagnostics.message: Every sampled value in the plot layer is non-finite.
suggested_repairs: Check the expression, domain, and numerical coercions.

diagnostics.message: The plot layer has no data to render.
suggested_repairs: Provide data or adjust the sampling domain.

diagnostics.message: Some sampled values are non-finite and render as gaps.
suggested_repairs: Inspect discontinuities or restrict the domain if the gaps are unintended.

diagnostics.message: WebGL content will be rasterized in a vector export.
suggested_repairs: Use HTML for interactive vector-like output or accept embedded raster content.

diagnostics.message: The plot layer is present but effectively invisible.
suggested_repairs: Increase opacity, marker size, or line width.

diagnostics.message: The plot layer lies outside the visible viewport.
suggested_repairs: Expand the viewport or revise the layer coordinates.

diagnostics.message: More than one plot layer uses the same legend label.
suggested_repairs: Use distinct labels or group the layers intentionally.

diagnostics.message: A visible legend entry has no useful label.
suggested_repairs: Assign a concise legend label or hide the entry.

diagnostics.message: A frontend option could not be represented and was ignored.
suggested_repairs: Use the suggested Plotly-native alternative when available.

diagnostics.message: A frontend option was translated to Plotly-native behavior.
suggested_repairs: Inspect the diagnostic details for the exact translation.

diagnostics.message: The serialized plot payload is excessively large.
suggested_repairs: Downsample, simplify geometry, or rasterize an appropriate layer.

diagnostics.message: The plot uses an excessive number of samples.
suggested_repairs: Request a lower-cost preview or reduce the sampling density.

diagnostics.message: Distinct plot layers use colors that are difficult to distinguish.
suggested_repairs: Use a categorical palette with more separation.

diagnostics.message: Foreground and background colors have low contrast.
suggested_repairs: Choose a higher-contrast color or theme.

diagnostics.message: Text labels are likely to overlap.
suggested_repairs: Move, shorten, or selectively hide labels.
